status: Final pinned public packet received on LinkedIn; original archive retrieved; official intake unresolved
claims: Ramsey: exact weighted 1024-block template, Q=50762939; density 200137750014677779172692777477/6640289795261907019148161833841, density_ppt=30139911990. Lean finite count and blow-up/limit upper bound claimed; c4 is not determined.
Kobon: existence of 39 distinct lines and 471 pairwise disjoint bounded triangles. Lean 4.33.1 existence/certificate claimed; K(39) maximality and historical priority not proved.

DMS star-edge-colouring: 5 colours for specified infinite families (flower/Goldberg snarks, GP(n,k), k<=15, Mobius ladders); 6 colours for all bridgeless cubic loopless multigraphs up to 14 vertices; equivalent cubic>=16 formulation and reductions to OPEN hypotheses. General conjecture remains open.

M2 selected set: 17 proposed families / 24 theorems, comprising connected Petersen/Schonberger perfect-matching family and 16 Erdos problems. Ten substantive families (G-PM,E942,E44,E123,E918,E292,E395,E698,E939,E477), seven minor/sanity families (E295,E703,E748,E1136,E358,E619,E1148). Optional and duplicate pools preserved but not promoted to selected results.
BB6 n0rang2: exact 249881-step / 554-one / 735-span halting witness with Lean certificate; baseline-tied finite witness, not global BB6 maximality.

Additional held-out hl728 Ramsey density_ppt=30141921123, n18 Youchan Kobon=93, CHSH-type Grothendieck witness, support139 known matrix scheme, 234 Collatz rules and n0rang2 Ramsey lead retained. No automatic novelty credit for baseline ties.
Erdos #1038 package explicitly NOT CLAIMED due to prior public formal proof; partial rebuild and provenance retained.
